title.zh: 矩陣組織領導力與跨部門利益對齊 (專案負責人/中階主管視角)
title.en: Matrix Leadership & Cross-Functional Alignment (Project Lead Perspective)

slide_title.zh: 專案願景與無權威影響力 (SCQA & The Shared Mandate)

zh: 情境 (Situation)：公司高層已正式拍板 [核心專案名稱]，要求在 Q3 落地，以應對市場競爭與客戶流失的危機
衝突 (Complication)：我們處於矩陣式組織，專案的成功高度依賴在座各部門 (IT, 業務, 法務) 的火力支援，但各位手上皆已有繁重的既有 KPI
戰略訴求 (The Ask)：今日的啟動會議 (Kickoff) 不是來發號施令，而是透過「利益對齊 (Alignment)」，確立這項專案如何幫助各部門達成你們自己的年度目標
en: Situation: Executive leadership has officially mandated [Core Project Name] for Q3 deployment to counter aggressive market competition and client churn.

Complication: We operate in a matrix structure. This project's success completely depends on bandwidth from your departments (IT, Sales, Legal), all of whom are already at 100% capacity with local KPIs.

The Ask: Today's Kickoff is not a dictatorship; it is an 'Alignment Summit.' We are here to establish exactly how contributing to this project actively accelerates the achievement of your own departmental goals.

speaker_notes.zh: 各位主管，感謝大家百忙之中來參加啟動會議。我知道大家桌上都疊滿了自己部門的 KPI。身為專案負責人，我沒有權力命令各位做事。今天我們坐在這裡，不是因為『老闆交代』，而是因為這個專案跟我們所有人都有切身利益。如果不把這座山頭打下來，業務會掉單，IT 會面臨更多的系統維護客訴。我們是在同一條船上。
speaker_notes.en: Team leaders, thank you for joining this Kickoff. I am acutely aware your desks are overflowing with departmental KPIs. As the Project Lead, I possess zero formal authority to dictate your bandwidth. We are in this room today not because of an 'executive mandate,' but because this initiative impacts all our bottom lines. If we fail here, Sales misses quotas, and IT inherits massive tech-debt complaints. We sink or swim together.

slide_title.zh: 語境翻譯與共贏矩陣 (Contextual Translation & Win-Win Matrix)

zh: 對接業務部 (Sales Alignment)：本專案不僅是「系統升級」，而是將為前線提供自動化工具，預計可節省 20% 的行政時間，直接轉化為打擊對手的火力
對接資訊部 (IT Alignment)：趁著本次專案的預算，我們將順勢汰換掉 IT 部門一直想拔除的 [舊有系統模組]，大幅降低未來的維護技術債
對接人資/法務 (HR/Legal Alignment)：將合規檢核自動化，減少法務人工審閱的風險，並將專案成就列入參與成員的年度高績效 (Talent Pool) 評估
en: Sales Alignment: This is not just an 'IT upgrade.' This provides frontline automation projected to eliminate 20% of admin overhead, converting directly into selling time.
IT Alignment: We will leverage this project's CapEx to simultaneously sunset the [Legacy Module] your team despises, massively reducing your future technical debt.
HR/Legal Alignment: Automating compliance checks to reduce Legal's manual liability exposure, while ensuring project contributors receive high-visibility 'Talent Pool' recognition in annual reviews.

speaker_notes.zh: 跨部門合作最大的問題是『語言不通』。所以，我已經把專案目標翻譯成了各位的 KPI。對業務部來說，這是幫你們賺業績的武器；對 IT 來說，這筆預算可以順便幫你們把最討厭的舊系統換掉；對法務來說，我們把合規寫進程式裡，降低你們的風險。這不是在幫我做專案，這是在幫各位解決你們的部門痛點。
speaker_notes.en: The root cause of cross-functional friction is speaking different dialects. I have explicitly translated our project mandate into your specific KPIs. For Sales, this is a weapon to hit quota. For IT, we are utilizing this budget to kill the legacy system you hate. For Legal, we are hard-coding compliance to reduce your risk exposure. You aren't doing my project a favor; this project is actively solving your operational pain points.

slide_title.zh: RACI 當責矩陣與決策邊界 (RACI Matrix & Decision Boundaries)

zh: 當責者 (Accountable)：作為專案負責人，我承擔最終成敗與高層究責 (A)；各位是關鍵的執行者與決策守門員 (R)
專業尊重與否決權 (Consulted & Veto)：在涉及 [資安/法務合規] 的節點上，專業部門擁有絕對的「諮詢權 (C)」與「一票否決權」。專案絕不凌駕於企業安全之上
消除資訊落差 (Informed)：建立透明的週報與看板機制，確保所有利害關係人 (Stakeholders) 隨時處於「被知會 (I)」狀態，拒絕黑箱作業
en: Accountable (A): As Project Lead, I carry the ultimate Executive Accountability (A) for failure. You are the critical Responsible (R) execution partners and gatekeepers.

Consulted & Veto (C): On critical nodes involving [Cybersecurity/Legal], your departments retain absolute 'Consulted' rights and a definitive Veto. Project speed will never override enterprise security.
Informed (I) Transparency: Deploying transparent weekly dashboards to guarantee all stakeholders remain perfectly 'Informed.' Zero black-box operations.

speaker_notes.zh: 在權責劃分上，我們嚴格遵守 RACI 矩陣。大家放心，專案如果搞砸了，老闆找的是我，我扛下最終的當責 (A)。但在執行過程中，我絕對尊重各位的專業。如果 IT 覺得資安有漏洞，或者法務覺得合規有風險，你們有一票否決權，我們停下來解決再走。我承諾給各位 100% 的資訊透明，絕不讓任何人在老闆面前背黑鍋。
speaker_notes.en: Regarding governance, we strictly enforce the RACI matrix. Rest assured, if this project fails, the C-Suite holds me Accountable (A); I take the bullet. However, during execution, I bow to your expertise. If IT flags a cyber vulnerability, or Legal flags compliance, you have a hard veto. We stop and fix it. I guarantee 100% operational transparency; no one in this room will ever be blindsided in front of the executive committee.

slide_title.zh: 衝突升級機制與心理安全感 (Escalation Path & Psychological Safety)

zh: 建設性衝突 (Constructive Friction)：鼓勵在會議桌上進行無情的邏輯辯論。我們對「事」極度嚴苛，對「人」保持絕對尊重
明確的升級路徑 (Escalation Protocol)：當跨部門發生資源排擠或意見僵局時，禁止私下抱怨。必須在 48 小時內啟動「雙首長調解機制 (Dual-Head Mediation)」
無責備驗屍 (Blameless Post-mortem)：若專案中途遭遇挫折，我們只檢討「流程與系統」哪裡出錯，絕對不進行「獵巫 (Witch-hunt)」式的個人究責
en: Constructive Friction: We actively encourage ruthless, logic-based debate in this room. We are exceptionally hard on the 'problem,' but maintain absolute respect for the 'person.'

Escalation Protocol: When cross-silo resource deadlocks occur, backchannel complaining is prohibited. We mandate a 'Dual-Head Mediation' escalation within 48 hours to resolve the blocker structurally.
Blameless Post-mortem: If we hit a critical failure mid-flight, we audit the 'process and system,' never the individual. Witch-hunts are strictly banned.

speaker_notes.zh: 跨部門一定會有摩擦，這很正常。我希望大家把話攤在桌上說。我們對問題可以很殘酷，但對同事要很溫柔。如果遇到我們這層級解決不了的僵局，不要私下抱怨，我們啟動『升級機制 (Escalation)』，請雙方的 VP 坐下來調解。最重要的是，如果在過程中我們犯了錯，我們只檢討流程，絕對不抓戰犯。在這個團隊裡，你們擁有絕對的心理安全感。
speaker_notes.en: Cross-functional friction is inevitable and healthy. I want all disagreements on the table. We will be ruthless on the issues, but fiercely protective of each other. If we hit a resource deadlock we cannot resolve at our level, there is no backchannel gossiping. We trigger the Escalation Protocol and have our respective VPs mediate. Most importantly, when failures occur, we audit the process, not the person. You have absolute psychological safety in this team.

slide_title.zh: 資源承諾與下一步行動 (Resource Commitment & Next Steps)

zh: 明確的資源索求 (The Explicit Ask)：根據評估，我們需要 [A 部門] 每週投入 [X] 小時，[B 部門] 派駐一名資深專員 (FTE) 參與 90 天的衝刺 (Sprint)
首週快速通關 (First-Week Quick Wins)：鎖定一個可以在 7 天內完成的小型里程碑，透過「早期勝利 (Quick Win)」建立跨部門團隊的協作信心
決策訴求 (Call to Action)：懇請各位主管今日點頭放行資源，並簽署本專案的「跨部門協作備忘錄 (MOU)」，讓我們即刻啟動
en: The Explicit Ask: Based on our scoping, we require [Dept A] to commit [X] hours weekly, and [Dept B] to dedicate one senior FTE for a 90-day Sprint.
First-Week Quick Wins: Surgically targeting a low-hanging milestone executable within 7 days. Securing a 'Quick Win' instantly synthesizes cross-silo trust and momentum.
Call to Action: Requesting your verbal commitment today for these bandwidth allocations, and your sign-off on the internal 'Cross-Functional MOU' so we can launch immediately.

speaker_notes.zh: 前面的大方向都對齊了，現在我們來談硬核的資源。我不喜歡給模糊的數字，這是我精算過後，需要各位支援的人力與工時。為了證明這個團隊能打仗，我設計了一個 7 天內就能達成的小目標。讓我們用一場小勝利，來證明跨部門合作是真的可行的。如果各位對剛才的利益對齊沒有異議，請答應我這份資源請求，我們現在就開工。
speaker_notes.en: We've aligned on the macro vision; now we finalize the hard math. I don't deal in vague requests. This is the exact bandwidth and FTE commitment required from your teams. To prove this hybrid squad is lethal, I have engineered a milestone we will crush within 7 days. We will use this 'Quick Win' to forge our team's operational momentum. If you agree with the Win-Win Matrix we discussed, I ask for your hard commitment on these resources today. Let's get to work.

prompt_template.zh: 請以繁體中文製作一份大師級的『矩陣組織領導力與跨部門利益對齊』簡報。受眾為即將參與專案的各平行部門主管 (如 IT、業務、法務)。內容必須展現專案負責人 (PM/Director) 在『無權威影響力』下的頂級談判與調解 (Mediation) 技巧：1. 運用 SCQA 確立專案的急迫性，並將公司目標轉化為各部門的共同利益，2. 進行『語境翻譯』，精準點出參與專案能如何幫各部門解決痛點或達成 KPI，3. 確立 RACI 矩陣，承擔最終究責 (Accountable) 的同時，賦予專業部門一票否決權，4. 建立明確的『衝突升級機制 (Escalation)』與無責備的心理安全感，5. 結尾給出明確的資源索求 (工時/FTE)，並規劃 7 天內的早期勝利 (Quick Win)。每張 Slide 不超過 3 個重點，語氣需極具同理心、邏輯嚴密且充滿凝聚跨部門團隊的領袖魅力。
prompt_template.en: Please create a master-class 'Matrix Leadership & Cross-Functional Alignment' presentation in English. Audience: Peer department heads (e.g., IT, Sales, Legal) participating in a matrix project. Demonstrate the elite negotiation and Mediation mastery required to exert 'Influence Without Authority': 1. Use SCQA to frame the project urgency, translating a corporate mandate into shared departmental interests. 2. Execute 'Contextual Translation,' explicitly proving how contributing to this project solves their specific local KPIs. 3. Establish a rigorous RACI matrix, accepting ultimate Accountability (A) while granting expert peers explicit Veto power. 4. Architect clear 'Escalation Protocols' and enforce psychological safety (Blameless Post-mortems). 5. Conclude with a hyper-specific Resource Ask (Hours/FTE) and a roadmap for a 7-day 'Quick Win.' Max 3 bullet points per slide. The tone must project immense empathy, airtight logic, and the magnetic leadership required to unite organizational silos.
